description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to Amend the Gaz.Ex.No. 2153/12 that Published the Function and duties of Ministries
reasoning: This gazette notification names President Gotabaya Rajapaksa and contains detailed amendments to ministerial portfolio responsibilities, specifically modifying the functions and institutions under the "Minister of Information and Mass Media" and adding new responsibilities to the "Minister of Defence" portfolio. It includes both the specific individual (the President) and detailed descriptions of government responsibilities and subject areas, meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette.
